card_optimizer_agent.name: Card Optimizer Agent
card_optimizer_agent.description: Analyzes user's expense categories against their card portfolio's reward structures and recommends the optimal card for each spending category to maximize total rewards.

card_alternatives_agent.name: Card Alternatives Agent
card_alternatives_agent.description: Evaluates user's spending patterns and current card portfolio, then searches for alternative credit cards offering better overall value.

rewards_strategist_agent.name: Rewards Strategist Agent
rewards_strategist_agent.description: Tracks point balances across all user cards and provides optimal redemption strategies to recommend the highest-value redemption path.
